title: A goal clause whose item leaves a planned sprint can be dropped from the sprint's goal with backlog.py
goal: Retrospective of SP-vayhvwfy: the operator moved ST-a5hhfp3z out at start, but backlog.py set refuses --goal on a sprint ('a sprint takes notes, links and delegates only'), so its clause stayed in the goal text, recorded only in the sprint's notes, and close --summary listed it unmet. Before or at start, backlog.py drops a clause from a planned sprint's goal (or move --sprint none offers to), naming the item that left.

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/bl_items.py',encoding='utf-8').read();ok='a sprint takes notes, links and delegates only' not in t;print('set accepts a sprint goal edit:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
